budget_items.topic: FY14 proposed transfer to Retained Earnings
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The proposed transfer to Retained Earnings in the FY14 budget was the starting figure, and the meeting's task was to review the budget and reduce it.
budget_items.quote: the proposed transfer to retained earnings was at $204,943.66.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The outsourcing line used a general assumption of a $100,000 cost, with savings from personnel and vehicle maintenance discussed against it.
budget_items.quote: outsourcing line item used a general assumption of $100,000 cost.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Engineering services included an I/I project of $65,000 for home inspections to find illegal connections; Weston & Sampson had proposed a $65k project for the Whalom area.
budget_items.quote: engineering services include the l/l project of $65,000 for the home inspections to discover illegal connections.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Fitchburg's capital cost was discussed; a $66K capital estimate was removed from the operating figures, and it would likely come from Retained Earnings by Town Meeting vote.
budget_items.quote: the capital estimate of $66k was removed.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Raising connection fees to $2250 was discussed, applying to all customers, since Fitchburg proposes $2000; $250 was said to cover Lunenburg's inspection and administration costs.
budget_items.quote: commission discussed raising connection fees to $2250 since fitchburg is proposing a connection fee of $2000

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Connection fees are to increase 7/1/13, and the increase could be advertised to encourage sign-ups before then.
budget_items.quote: connection fees will increase 7/1/13 - and we could advertise the increase

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Some towns were said to add $150-200 for I/I remediation; the Commission agreed to double the license fee to $100.
budget_items.quote: corey had stated at one time that some towns add in for i/l remediation $150-200.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Rates were discussed to cut the deficit, citing prior Fitchburg and Leominster increases; raising the minimum to the standard rate was proposed.
budget_items.quote: we could increase that this year to the standard rate of 9.72/cf or $97.20 (an increase of $16.20/qtr).
